This email confirms the resolution of your billing discrepancy (Ticket #C-6994). We have:

1. Corrected your plan tier to **PLATINUM-WJOP** (previously billed incorrectly).
2. Issued a refund of **80 units** for the overbilled period.

The refund has been processed and will reflect in your account within 24 hours. If you notice any further discrepancies, reply to this email or contact our support team.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
